title: Zoning text change for 158-06 Northern Boulevard, Queens
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment designating a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 158-06 Northern Boulevard in Murray Hill, Queens. It is paired with a related zoning map amendment to enable a new 10-story mixed-use building with 76 apartments, including 19 income-restricted units. The Council held a public hearing on the application on August 12, 2026.
